game_concept: A speed quiz set in Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge, a bridge in a blizzard: the innkeeper must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Helper Factory: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush.
theme: Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge: a bridge in a blizzard
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Bridge, repeat each round: Refactor repeated code into helper functions to save time during a rush. Each round, a new warm lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the refactor_score value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 290 points of warm lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Helper Factory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Helper Factory' (Week 6 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Blizzard Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how refactor_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Blizzard Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
